attchmntText: Udayshivakumar Infra Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Udayshivakumar Infra Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was INR 10,269.53 Lakhs, an increase of 122.03 percent over the previous quarter. EBITDA stood at INR 951.04 Lakhs, up 30.54 percent. Net profit for the quarter was INR 146.48 Lakhs. For the half year, revenue from operations was INR 5,770.73 Lakhs, and net profit was INR 81.61 Lakhs. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report on the financial results.
